root_cause: The command supplied a new experiment-local cache root instead of the existing canonical VS3 object-vector cache. The runtime correctly began CUDA computation, but completing it would create a duplicate 33,085-object vector cache with identical model and object identities.
impact: The attempt was stopped during CUDA BGE object embedding before Qwen embedding, reranking, result materialization, Evidence promotion or Runtime mutation.
disposition: Use a new attempt ID and bind execution to .codex_runtime/fin_0_1_3_s1_vs3_candidate_ranking so immutable cache identities are reused and only new query/pair work executes.
